verses.text: A song. A psalm of the sons of Korah. The LORD is great and deserves great praise in the city of our God, on his holy mountain.
Mount Zion, high and beautiful, is the joy of the whole earth. It is like the highest point of the north, the city of the great King.
God is in its strong towers. He has shown that he is its fortress.
Look, kings joined forces and marched together against it.
But when they saw it, they were amazed. They were terrified and ran away.
They were seized with trembling there, with pain like a woman giving birth.
You destroyed them like ships of Tarshish wrecked by an east wind.
What we have heard, we have now seen in the city of the LORD of Armies, the city of our God. God will make it secure forever. Selah.
God, in your temple we think about your faithful love.
God, your praise reaches to the ends of the earth, just like your name. Your right hand is full of goodness.
Let Mount Zion be glad! Let the towns of Judah celebrate because of your fair judgments.
Walk around Zion. Go all the way around it. Count its towers.
Look closely at its walls. Go through its strong places, so you can tell the next generation about them.
This God is our God forever and ever. He will be our guide even to the end.
